scope: Second set of three sequential source and regression reviews for recovery checks and their compatibility; no authentication capability changes.

rounds.focus: Real UCI quoting, multiline values and native absence evidence
rounds.source_contract: UCI quote printer emits literal newlines inside single-quoted strings and escapes embedded single quotes. Seven fixed libuci/CLI source versions reviewed.
findings: Line-based baseline parsing could interpret a multiline value as a real disabled flag.
A multiline value could create a spurious unrelated interface in the saved baseline.
Scanning full show output for a section prefix could report a nonexistent temporary section as remaining.
repairs: Parse complete shell-quoted records with the standard lexical parser; do not execute text. Bound input and record count and reject malformed quotes or duplicate fields.
Check absence only from exit status 1 plus the exact native UCI Entry-not-found reply for the explicitly addressed key. I/O errors, silence or unrecognized replies remain unconfirmed.
Do not keep or scan full private configuration in the remote readback shell.

rounds.focus: Unknown original runtime state and scoped recovery
rounds.finding: An original disabled field with unknown or nonboolean type could be skipped and recovery marked verified.
rounds.repair: Require a known boolean original disabled state and matching recovered state on affected radios; unrelated radios do not block checks.

rounds.focus: Cross-version error contracts, quote escapes/list values, malformed input, lifecycle and privacy
additional_regressions: Single-quote escape, hash characters and list values preserve original flags.
Unterminated quotes and duplicate fields fail before wireless modification.
Native UCI I/O error or silent lookup failure never proves absence.
Existing cancel/error cleanup and export redaction remain covered.
rounds.result: No further deterministic defect established in this review after the repairs.

compatibility.runtime_contracts: Earlier exact netifd and deployed 25.12 ucode contracts retained and their source hashes rechecked.
compatibility.hardware: No model/radio-number shortcuts or architecture-dependent code added; representative model identity evidence retains its prior limited scope.
not_proven: True recovery on every model and driver
Complete upstream wireless association or Internet connectivity

validation.skip_reason: Existing Debian/POSIX environment test is skipped on Windows; generated recovery commands separately executed in local Git Bash.

limits: Unknown native CLI variants or changed error wording conservatively produce unconfirmed recovery.
State is checked once after the existing reload; pending state is not forced to settle by retry timers or extra reloads.
This review is not proof of zero bugs or universal compatibility.
